programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​揭開沼澤地那詭異卻迷人的面紗: 這些濕地數百年來激發了無數傳說與民間故事,同時成為連結生與死的重要橋樑。與飢餓的鱷魚一同潛泳,目睹梅花鹿為了覓食而賭上性命的瞬間,並觀察食肉植物迅速捕捉獵物的驚人畫面。

programme.title: 魔幻水域的祕密 #6
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​讓時間凝結,見證水在地球最冰冷的生態系中,如何化為改變的力量。與北極熊一同獵捕毫無防備的海豹,與獼猴在天然的溫泉中沐浴取暖,並體驗北極狐那獨特而靈巧的生存策略。

programme.title: 進化的奧秘 #5
programme.desc: 世上有多種合作形式。一些動物合作群居,而另一些動物則將群體利益置於自身的繁殖潛力之上。看看物種為了生存而進化成互相合作的眾多方式。

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #2
programme.desc: 帛琉雖是一個小國,但卻大有故事。2009年,這個位於西太平洋中部的島國創造了世上第一個鯊魚保育區,以保護100多種鯊魚免受魯莽的過度捕撈和殘酷又商業化的魚翅製造業。而在2014年時,帛琉再次領先全球,建立了世上最大的海洋保育區 - 一個幾乎與加州面積相同的外國商業捕魚禁區。

programme.title: 阿拉斯加的夏天 英普
programme.desc: 《阿拉斯加的夏天》以令人驚嘆的高動態範圍成像方法拍攝,展現了美國最北部州份充滿活力的雄偉景緻。從令人驚嘆的小灣、海灣和水灣所展示巴拉諾夫島的崎嶇之美,到座頭鯨和虎鯨在參天的冰川和高聳的山脈間那平靜的水域中暢遊的冰川灣,這是阿拉斯加與眾不同的旅程。

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #1
programme.desc: 在海陸相連的公園中,自然元素相互結合,創造出美妙的多樣性。可樂色的水使森林變得翠綠和茂密。火與風促進多樣性的增長,岩石形成了眾多面貌的海岸線。生命在這裡茁壯成長 - 從壯麗到奇異,這是花園大道國家公園。

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #2
programme.desc: 在克留格爾國家公園北部,賴以維生的元素就是水。在炎熱和乾旱的土地上,一條絲帶在荒野中切割出可靠的路線。它是不論大小所有生物的生命線。

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #3
programme.desc: 偉大的奧蘭治河有著56米高壯觀的奧赫拉比斯瀑布。奧赫拉比斯源於「oukurubes」這個詞,在南瑪改的土著語言中意思是「雷霆之地」,這片土地是一個苛刻和陽光充沛世界的中心,充滿絢麗色彩和雷鳴般的咆哮。

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #4
programme.desc: 地球上從最小到最大的任何生物都離不開食物、水和住所,沿著非洲最大河流之一的河岸,一些動物極力求生,而另一些則茁壯成長。所有動物都為尋找生存所需展開旅程,牠們必須決定在何時何地移動來獲取成功這就是贊比西河下游的神奇世界。

programme.title: 非洲園遊誌 #5
programme.desc: 在南非祖魯蘭中心地帶,有著非洲大陸最古老的野生動物保護區 - 赫盧赫盧韋 - 烏姆福洛濟禁獵區。南方白犀牛在動盪時期於此找到了保護。在19世紀末幾乎因為被捕獵而完全滅絕,公園的建立為犀牛提供了一條生路 - 讓牠們從絕種中恢復過來。

programme.title: 風之島 #4
programme.desc: 位於明尼亞瑞亞國家公園的一座人造湖,養育了亞洲最大的象群。跟隨一頭年輕公象,他正在經歷成長的轉折點。走訪熱帶雨林,探索棲居於叢林中各種奇異的昆蟲。

programme.title: 風之島 #5
programme.desc: 季候風暴席捲斯里蘭卡的熱帶島嶼,帶著旋風的薄霧和水流襲擊了山區的心臟地帶,開展島上森林許多不斷變化的面貌。

programme.title: 風之島 #6
programme.desc: 雅拉國家公園是一個鳥類伊甸園,是215種鳥類的家。這個天堂為能度過不斷變化氣候的父母提供了許多可能性。 在旱季結束和季侯風風暴開始前,每個物種都必須在這裡飼養後代或找到新家。

programme.title: 靈長大地 #1
programme.desc: 數百萬年前,被遺棄的生物發現自己被困在馬達加斯加崎嶇的海岸上,與大陸隔絕,新來者唯有進化。這是一個神奇的世界,稀有而獨特的動物完美地適應了牠們的熱帶世外桃源。

programme.title: 靈長大地 #2
programme.desc: 這島是狐猴的天地。狐猴是馬達加斯加迷人的樹棲原始靈長類動物,從最大的大狐猴到倭狐猴,各種大小、顏色和形狀都有。

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力。當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 與獸醫貝克一起經歷為考拉喬伊做人工呼吸的生死搏鬥,目睹獸醫密根在小果蝠的小腳趾上測試她的顯微手術技巧。捕捉一條討厭洗澡的蟒蛇,跟隨救援人員喬捕捉一隻被困的谷倉貓頭鷹倉鸮。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 看看高級獸醫蒂姆指導新員工菲爾檢查受傷的考拉,並跟隨團隊為飽受夏季高溫困擾的動物們提供解決方案。共同慶祝獸醫卡琳娜解決了一個令人費解的青蛙問題,並放飛一個準備好飛翔的老朋友。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #3
programme.desc: 了解獸醫菲爾處理令人棘手患者的巧妙策略,以及RSPCA救援人員香特爾從煙囪中救出一對滿身煙灰的負鼠的故事。為診所里最受歡迎的倖存者歡呼,再看看獸醫密根如何解開今天捕獲的杓鷸身上的鉤子。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #4
programme.desc: 加入團隊的爭奪,幫助三只痛苦的小袋鼠和一隻癲癇發作的考拉。與救援者喬一起爬樹,將受傷的蜥蜴網起來,觀看笑翠鳥的羽毛植入手術,欣賞琵鷺的新矯正鞋。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #5
programme.desc: 隨著診所一同處理布里斯班洪水後的動物善後事宜,進入恢復模式。了解一隻需要全天候護理的袋鼠寶寶,和一隻被沖下下水道的鴴。然後看一看獸醫卡琳娜耐心處理的海龜等待名單。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #6
programme.desc: 觀察獸醫卡琳娜為拯救一隻被狗咬傷的考拉而進行的努力,然後與獸醫蒂姆一起面對診所最難對付的顧客: 一隻咬人速度極快的彩虹變色鸚鵡。與救援者香特爾一起挖出一隻憤怒的負鼠,然後與照料一群小鹅的梅根建立友誼。

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力。當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #1
programme.desc: 與獸醫貝克一起經歷為考拉喬伊做人工呼吸的生死搏鬥,目睹獸醫密根在小果蝠的小腳趾上測試她的顯微手術技巧。捕捉一條討厭洗澡的蟒蛇,跟隨救援人員喬捕捉一隻被困的谷倉貓頭鷹倉鸮。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #2
programme.desc: 看看高級獸醫蒂姆指導新員工菲爾檢查受傷的考拉,並跟隨團隊為飽受夏季高溫困擾的動物們提供解決方案。共同慶祝獸醫卡琳娜解決了一個令人費解的青蛙問題,並放飛一個準備好飛翔的老朋友。

programme.title: 野生動物急診室 #3

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #2
programme.desc: 現在是六月,公園沐浴在17個小時的日光之中。溫暖的氣溫帶來了豐收,但對新生兒來說,夏季很重要,因牠們要學習戰鬥、覓食和躲避掠食者。

programme.title: 野外的一年: 羅莽湖 #3
programme.desc: 秋季是雄鹿爭相繁殖、魚鷹雛鳥開展3000英里西非遷徙、三文魚返回牠們出生的河流、極北蝰產子的季節。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #9
programme.desc: 華倫正離開開普敦前往西開普省更寧靜的沿海地區和風景如畫的帕特諾斯特小鎮。他在當地會驚嘆海邊村莊的氛圍,並沿著海灘騎電動單車。

programme.title: 美食足跡: 南非 2 #10
programme.desc: 作為華倫南非美食之旅的最後一章,他回歸叢林,這是所有前往彩虹國度旅行的精髓。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #1
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大另類療法,並瞭解那些至今仍保留傳統的療法。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #2
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大有著臺灣風味的西餐。跟她瞭解為何這些食物在當地人和遊客中如此受歡迎。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #3
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺北五間最多善信到訪的寺廟。跟她瞭解各寺廟崇拜的神明,以及人們在各寺廟祈禱的內容。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #4
programme.desc: 祖莉探索臺灣五大原住民美食。跟她參觀兩個原住民村莊,並瞭解這些食物的製作方法。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #5
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大獨特街頭美食。她也嘗試製作一些,並瞭解它們各具特色的原因。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #6
programme.desc: 祖莉探索五大臺灣製造的頂尖發明。細訴這些改變生活的物品的起源,並瞭解為何那麼多人喜歡它們。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #7
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣地鐵站五大裝置藝術,並細訴它們如何呼應這些車站的地理位置。

programme.title: 台灣之最 #8
programme.desc: 碧姬探索臺灣五大咖啡品牌。她向獲獎的咖啡師們瞭解能在激烈競爭中脫穎而出的原因。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #5
programme.desc: 透過檔案錄像見證柯林頓總統被彈劾當天的故事。

programme.title: 消失的錄影帶 2 #6
programme.desc: 見證美國南部和中西部如何在短短18小時內遭受148個龍捲風肆虐。

programme.title: 恐龍效應
programme.desc: 《恐龍效應》是一部關於現今加拿大古生物學復興的紀錄片,恐龍能怎樣教導我們有關氣候變化的知識。

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #5
programme.desc: 如果比特幣挖礦真能拯救世界會發生甚麼事?我們在本集會認識一家當地公司,其使命是藉此幫助解決全球暖化問題。

programme.title: 加密貨幣大解密 #6
programme.desc: 讓我們介紹鄧嘉瑪,一位開發數碼資料主權的創造家,並瞭解非同質化代幣如何讓我們擁有自己的人工智能。這是能震撼你的一集。

programme.title: 電腦遊戲: 電玩的故事
programme.desc: 《電腦遊戲: 電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片。歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光。從《乓》到《食鬼》、《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》、《毀滅戰士》、《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事。

programme.title: PlayStation 的故事
programme.desc: 隨著電子遊戲崛起,科技巨頭索尼嘗試與任天堂合作。但在一次驚人的背叛後,索尼創立了後來成為世上最成功的遊戲主機。Playstation從此屹立不倒。

programme.title: 任天堂的故事
programme.desc: 由製造「花札」卡牌默默發跡,到成為世上最受認可的電子遊戲公司之一,從瑪利歐和路易吉的誕生到大金剛和薩爾達⋯⋯到擊敗競爭對手並成為高品質遊戲和強大價值的平台。這就是任天堂的故事。

programme.title: 前進宇宙: 太空、競賽、火星與更遠之處

programme.title: 成名之旅 #10

programme.title: 成名之旅 #9

programme.desc: 瑪莉莎在雲莉塔的法庭上為馬堤奧努力辯護,而戴雁則嘗試找他訪談;麗茲和阿勒瓜為毒販奧斯卡李飛辯護。

programme.title: 傲骨之戰 6 #1
programme.desc: 在晉升為律師樓高級合夥人後,麗茲被逼接受連利查成為新的冠名合夥人,幫助管理她員工和客戶的重擔。同時,黛雁經歷似曾相識感。

programme.title: 傲骨之戰 6 #2
programme.desc: 黛雁接受她的首次「治療」,開始以積極的眼光看待一切。

programme.title: 她不是我的女兒
programme.desc: 凱特和祖正考慮試管嬰兒,但17年前棄養的孩子卻出現。丹妮卡搬去和凱特同住,隨時間漸過,裂痕漸生,她真的是凱特的女兒嗎?

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #6
programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #7
programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪們的委託下前往拜訪多惠。她察覺這尊一到夜晚就會隨機電死大量魚群的木偶身上寄宿著落於本地的「某異物」之力,具備與世間常理相悖的神祕力量。琴子等人立即著手計劃消滅木偶,然而它身上卻隱藏著一個祕密。

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #16

programme.title: 排球少年 (第二季) #17
programme.desc: 因為大地的傷勢,緣下在與和久谷南的比賽中頂下了隊長的位置。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #7
programme.desc: 莉莉在與「素體」的戰鬥中精疲力竭,並失去了意識。阿久津抱起了她,並把她送回了她的房間。阿久津本欲離去,卻被意識模糊的莉莉抓住衣角,無法動彈。無奈之下,他只好坐在房間讀角落。過了一陣子,莉莉醒了過來。她發現阿久津已經睡著了,於是她便悄悄地接近了他的身邊。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #8
programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起從公寓中出來。儘管他們迫切地想要澄清他們並沒有共度一晚,但班上的同學卻沒有那麼容易放棄追問……這時候,夕香對阿久津提出了一個出乎意料的建議……她居然邀請他去約會……!?

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #9
programme.desc: 終於升為二年級生的同學們忐忑不安,不受影響的白石同學進入教室後開始找座位。此時有人告訴他答案,而那個人竟是久保同學,他後來得知葉月以及玉緒也在同一班。開班會決定班級委員時,白石同學如同去年擔任環境委員,同班同學的須藤同學卻好像也記得這件事。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #10
programme.desc: 明天是學校的體檢日,認為自己可能長得比白石同學還高的久保同學向他提議比身高。於是白石同學將背緊貼牆壁,讓對方將尺固定在他的頭上。換久保同學貼著牆壁量身高時,白石同學發現用手固定尺的姿勢彷彿是在對她壁咚。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #1
programme.desc: 花笑凜子在遭人推落後離奇死亡,轉生成小說中的登場人物——麥米倫家的千金萊利娜。萊利娜在小說中是一名配角,即將被未婚夫布魯克斯毒害身亡。凜子為了改變將死的命運,便主動向擁有極大權力的「第一王位繼承人」努爾公爵提出一筆交易。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #2
programme.desc: 為了正式締結契約,萊利娜獨自前往溫奈特家。她以努爾其實暗中持有新舊貴族對立下的王牌「玉璽」這項情報,試圖動搖對方來作為交易籌碼,但努爾卻不為所動。就在交易即將陷入不成立的危機之時,一張擺放突兀的棋盤映入萊利娜的眼簾。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #3
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了進行新娘修行而住進溫奈特家中。兩人試圖偽裝成相愛的未婚夫妻,卻連要如何稱呼彼此都遭遇到許多困難。雖然理智上知道這只不過是一段虛假的關係,並不需要事事做到完美,但萊利娜仍是一一完成接連強加於她身上的各項新娘修行任務。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #4
programme.desc: 萊利娜與努爾來到舞會會場,兩人的婚約在貴族之間備受矚目。萊利娜為了讓努爾欠自己人情,受其請託,正策劃著與艾利提爾侯爵夫人單獨會面,小說中的惡女角色薇薇安卻突然現身。不僅如此,一名盯上萊利娜的可疑人物也悄然現身。

programme.title: 海賊王 #16
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.desc: 夕香等人看到了阿久津和莉莉一起從公寓中出來。儘管他們迫切地想要澄清他們並沒有共度一晚,但班上的同學卻沒有那麼容易放棄追問……這時候,夕香對阿久津提出了一個出乎意料的建議……她居然邀請他去約會……!?

programme.title: 海賊王 #16
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #1
programme.desc: 花笑凜子在遭人推落後離奇死亡,轉生成小說中的登場人物——麥米倫家的千金萊利娜。萊利娜在小說中是一名配角,即將被未婚夫布魯克斯毒害身亡。凜子為了改變將死的命運,便主動向擁有極大權力的「第一王位繼承人」努爾公爵提出一筆交易。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #2
programme.desc: 為了正式締結契約,萊利娜獨自前往溫奈特家。她以努爾其實暗中持有新舊貴族對立下的王牌「玉璽」這項情報,試圖動搖對方來作為交易籌碼,但努爾卻不為所動。就在交易即將陷入不成立的危機之時,一張擺放突兀的棋盤映入萊利娜的眼簾。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #3
programme.desc: 萊利娜為了進行新娘修行而住進溫奈特家中。兩人試圖偽裝成相愛的未婚夫妻,卻連要如何稱呼彼此都遭遇到許多困難。雖然理智上知道這只不過是一段虛假的關係,並不需要事事做到完美,但萊利娜仍是一一完成接連強加於她身上的各項新娘修行任務。

programme.title: 她去公爵家的理由 #4
programme.desc: 萊利娜與努爾來到舞會會場,兩人的婚約在貴族之間備受矚目。萊利娜為了讓努爾欠自己人情,受其請託,正策劃著與艾利提爾侯爵夫人單獨會面,小說中的惡女角色薇薇安卻突然現身。不僅如此,一名盯上萊利娜的可疑人物也悄然現身。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #7
programme.desc: 白石同學順利撐過期末考期間,沒被沒收遊戲機。然而第三學期一旦結束便會重新分班,「自己被久保同學發現的日子可能會迎來尾聲」,白石同學開始有這種寂寞的心情。而到葉月家借住一晚的久保同學在談及分班話題時,腦中也自然浮現白石同學的身影。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #8
programme.desc: 明天準備賞花的久保同學、沙貴、明菜三人到超市採買,偶遇帶著誠太的白石同學。久保同學像平時那樣向兩人搭話,而誠太竟對沙貴一見鍾情,明菜見狀便邀白石同學與誠太一起去賞花。然而在隔天舉辦的賞花宴會上,喝醉的明菜掀起了一陣風波。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #9
programme.desc: 終於升為二年級生的同學們忐忑不安,不受影響的白石同學進入教室後開始找座位。此時有人告訴他答案,而那個人竟是久保同學,他後來得知葉月以及玉緒也在同一班。開班會決定班級委員時,白石同學如同去年擔任環境委員,同班同學的須藤同學卻好像也記得這件事。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #10
programme.desc: 明天是學校的體檢日,認為自己可能長得比白石同學還高的久保同學向他提議比身高。於是白石同學將背緊貼牆壁,讓對方將尺固定在他的頭上。換久保同學貼著牆壁量身高時,白石同學發現用手固定尺的姿勢彷彿是在對她壁咚。

programme.desc: 島井多惠和一隻妖貓生活在港口小鎮。當她路過漁港時,發現有大量的魚屍體被沖上岸,鎮民擔心這是「善太的詛咒」。戶平善太以已故孫子的外貌製作一尊木偶後便死去,從此木偶會在夜晚四處走動,小鎮上發生令人聯想到木偶皮諾丘童話的異變。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #7
programme.desc: 琴子在妖怪們的委託下前往拜訪多惠。她察覺這尊一到夜晚就會隨機電死大量魚群的木偶身上寄宿著落於本地的「某異物」之力,具備與世間常理相悖的神祕力量。琴子等人立即著手計劃消滅木偶,然而它身上卻隱藏著一個祕密。

programme.title: 虛構推理 (第二季) #8
programme.desc: 除了飯店經營外還發展各種事業的音無集團會長・音無剛一要求私下和琴子會面。他的妻子曾在路上遇到劫匪,因此喪命。剛一對琴子坦承是他間接害死了妻子,時日無多的剛一希望將自己是殺人犯的事實詳細告訴孩子們。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #10
programme.desc: 西片和高木同學一起去新年參拜,並進行今年的第一場比賽,而比賽方法和勝負結果究竟如何?高木同學在新年參拜時許下的願望又是…? 收錄「雪人」、「過年」、「商量」等四個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #12

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #7
programme.desc: 白石同學順利撐過期末考期間,沒被沒收遊戲機。然而第三學期一旦結束便會重新分班,「自己被久保同學發現的日子可能會迎來尾聲」,白石同學開始有這種寂寞的心情。而到葉月家借住一晚的久保同學在談及分班話題時,腦中也自然浮現白石同學的身影。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #8
programme.desc: 明天準備賞花的久保同學、沙貴、明菜三人到超市採買,偶遇帶著誠太的白石同學。久保同學像平時那樣向兩人搭話,而誠太竟對沙貴一見鍾情,明菜見狀便邀白石同學與誠太一起去賞花。然而在隔天舉辦的賞花宴會上,喝醉的明菜掀起了一陣風波。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #9
programme.desc: 終於升為二年級生的同學們忐忑不安,不受影響的白石同學進入教室後開始找座位。此時有人告訴他答案,而那個人竟是久保同學,他後來得知葉月以及玉緒也在同一班。開班會決定班級委員時,白石同學如同去年擔任環境委員,同班同學的須藤同學卻好像也記得這件事。

programme.title: 久保同學不放過我 #10
programme.desc: 明天是學校的體檢日,認為自己可能長得比白石同學還高的久保同學向他提議比身高。於是白石同學將背緊貼牆壁,讓對方將尺固定在他的頭上。換久保同學貼著牆壁量身高時,白石同學發現用手固定尺的姿勢彷彿是在對她壁咚。

programme.desc: 鼎爺和阿譚嚐過南海九江鎮著名的河鮮，返香港再炮製鮮蝦菜式。海中蝦啖啖肉，適合炮製「豉油王中蝦」，拉油後加豉油和調味料快炒，鼎爺怎樣憑蝦的彎度判斷熟度？九節蝦肉嫩爽脆，鼎爺白灼九節蝦，鎖着蝦的鮮味。而黃腳的九節蝦有何特別？鼎爺採用本地自然成長的豬肉，製作「雙冬蠔油燜豬肘」。為甚麼燜煮前要先白鑊烘豬肘？接着依次加入豉油、冬筍、冬菇等材料燜煮。鼎爺再沿用汁液來燜鵝翼，拉過油的鵝翼盡吸收豬肘的香味！

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：AI時代，讓子女世界放大粵
滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 耳鼻喉專科醫生指，兒童較易患急性中耳炎，多由病毒或病菌誘發，如嬰兒耳朵長期有分泌物、較易哭鬧，家長要特別留意！醫生如何透過耳鏡作出診斷？而治療此症以止痛為先，再按情況服用抗生素。冰壺也可以「傷健共融」，截肢者仇健明對其玩法極感興趣，輪椅冰壺的規則又有何不同？他近年參與創辦本地輪椅冰壺團體，並懷着初心與夢想，致力推廣、傳承這項運動！「睇餸食飯」，Annie為不嗜辣人士奉上「甜不辣咖喱雞」，同樣惹味。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在東莞粵
programme.desc: 東莞第一站，主持王祖藍首先帶大家到虎門逛海鮮市場。東莞臨江面海，水產特別豐富，而虎門位於珠江口入海位置，鹹淡水交界令虎門的海鮮特別鮮美，黃皮頭、東風螺、蟹餅……都是本地人喜愛的美味佳餚。此外，虎門還有一種名為「林旁粽」的非遺特產，觀眾們又可聽過？

programme.title: 單戀雙城#22粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)展博向式適求婚，式適感動。式適在展博家發現衣衫不整女人。錢進以一身誇張打扮向展禛表白。淇英帶男友參與聚會，感謝式適及錢進令她學懂自尊自重。式適到馬來西亞散心，確認恭梓是救她的白衣神將……

programme.title: 偶像星願7 Third BEAT!粵日
programme.desc: 陸在街上被人撞到病發，幸得狗丸透真出手相救。龍之介為自己的性感路線煩惱，宗助帶他去認識御堂虎於，著他向對方偷師。三月跑去質問大和，但大和堅持不說，兩人發生衝突，最終兩人都決定搬走。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 懷舊玩具之中，有一種是插畫師子健哥哥特別喜愛的，大家可跟着「Artspiration」的教學找答案。由多個長方形、圓形等簡單圖案組成，加上設計特別的手腳，還有關節、齒輪等細節，上鏈式的玩具機械人「面世」！假期共聚家庭樂，如未想好活動安排？不妨考慮投稿小朋友的「開心SHARE」。行山、玩棋類遊戲、做瑜伽、吃火鍋等家庭活動，主持們較喜愛哪一項？玲玲姐姐提到與家人「貼地」玩遊戲，會玩得特別投入？

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 隨著陽葵成為當紅偶像，生活繁忙，哥哥陽向開始感到擔心，繼而自告奮勇當上經理人，擅自為她安排滿滿的行程，令陽葵難以忍受，兩兄妹更因此大吵一頓。接著，當陽葵與美月談起自己的哥哥，二人便想到一個計劃……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
programme.desc: 藍田公屋一人單位，以暖色擴闊空間感，又訂造家具修飾開則，效果如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 保誠保險呈獻：AI時代，讓子女世界放大粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2758粵
programme.desc: 家聰的生日正值婦女節，碰巧力王要出埠工作；力蓮以為力王必會為家聰慶祝，便忙於籌辦婦女節晚宴。家聰認為其生日毫不受到重視，完全被婦女節搶盡風頭，深感不忿，此時意外發現身邊有不少跟他同一天生日的壽星，都是同病相憐。為奪回男人尊嚴，家聰提議要幹一番大事，藉此讓世人記得他們的生日，眾人為此作出不少嘗試，但毫無成效。其後，家聰意外發現可爭取將其生日設定為某地法定假期的機會，於是聯同眾人積極爭取……

programme.title: X Wallet呈獻:臥底嬌娃#10粵PG
programme.desc: 妙姿遭被炒的保鑣報復偷襲，江瀚東相救後卻暴打妙姿。奕風以為妙姿與瀚東有感情瓜葛，妙姿沒有澄清。佳琪替邦妮解決公司的公關災難，取得其信任，又答應為其集團提供意見。茹母認出歐凱，小茹遂與歐凱相認。妙姿得知學年與劉彪當年為爭邦妮而結怨，更發現大韋疑有腦退化症，似受制於學年。奕風潛入老人院，發現索帕與學年暗中會面，推測學年是其上線。奕風約索帕會面，遭宗南破壞。奕風以為是佳琪通風報信，佳琪始知被宗南利用。

programme.title: 機智女法醫2#2粵普PG
programme.desc: 景翊檢查石青時，她是會武功的，就馬上和景翊對打；石青承認是自己殺了伍兩，陛下決定節後處死；景翊和冷月發現伍兩家中有密室，裡面有不少珠寶和宮女寫給他的信，覺得宮女們還有事隱瞞，決定再試探其中一位宮女…

programme.title: 中國建設銀行(亞洲)呈獻：攻你上大學粵
programme.desc: 眾「女神」齊應考！譚凱琪、龔嘉欣、鄧凱文、梁敏巧、何沛珈、葉蒨文、羅毓儀、李芷晴、賴彥妤九位女同學，當中還有「女校男生」黎諾懿？小一題目考核鍵盤按鍵位置，某人用了錦囊都答錯？諾懿的大仔正讀小三，直言答錯小二英文題就即走！中文句子採用甚麼修辭手法，蒨文以演員角度思考並即席演繹……小五數學題似乎太易，令不少同學抱持自我質疑！沛珈入行前是註冊護士，小六常識題問到傷口護理，對她來說是優勢還是「釘牌」壓力？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

康業信貸快遞呈獻：尋秦記#18粵
programme.desc: 趙雅將真秘錄交給趙盤，吩咐他轉交少龍，又斬斷吊橋阻止趙穆追捕他。趙盤偷偷回家，發現遭蹂躪及奄奄一息的趙雅，悲憤交集。少龍等驚悉趙雅被凌辱致死。趙盤獨自找趙穆報仇反被擒。少龍以秘錄換取趙盤後，脅持趙穆帶他找朱姬母子，見到朱姬及怯懦無能的嬴政大感失望。趙穆乘亂傷嬴政逃走，又用煙火欲焗死三人，朱姬冷靜引領少龍等循地道逃出生天，嬴政已斷氣，朱姬無動於衷地說他不是真嬴政，並向應元及少龍訴說真嬴政寄居農家。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#48粵
programme.desc: 義正熱戀，溢找朋陪他打羽毛球，但義反哀求帶他散心。朋發現義對敏未死心，合全家之力指責義不是，令義面對現實，準備向娜提分手。可是欲「代兒出手」的慶準備說出一切時，娜欲突然暈倒，之後更傳出她已患上絕症！

programme.title: 天龍八部#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 阿紫落在丁春秋手裡，欲要逼問她王鼎的下落。此時慕容復出現，與丁春秋過了幾招，阿紫被丁春秋傷了眼睛，遊坦之及時出手將她救下。阿紫發現自己瞎了，難過不已，遊坦之答應會永遠陪在她身邊…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 元宵佳節，三位主持聯同「主婦look」示人的黃建東，闖進銅鑼灣鬧市應節，測試市民對男、女有關歇後語的認識。麥美恩、吳幸美被大學講師廖舜禧問到「拍拖」出處、「氹」字的正寫，可有獨到見解？俗語「三七二十一」出於戰國時代？且聽舜禧溯本尋源。主持們及後到訪鏡畫舖、磁廠及糖水店，又何以搬出「強盜照鏡」、「豬乸噍田螺」、「竹織鴨」等歇後語？「酸薑竹」比喻玩弄女士的男子，鄭寶鴻淺談當中歷史掌故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 美恩、幸美和茶餐廳老闆有個約會，探究「大髀痛」、「和尚跳海」，以及「打荷」等茶餐廳、食店廚房術語的奧妙。大學講師廖舜禧細談歷史人物歇後語，還講解「茅根竹」等「縮腳歇後語」特色、奄尖的「奄」與打尖的「尖」本字，及「一蚊雞」（一元）出處。「北角夜總會」形容別人經常遲到，掌故專家鄭寶鴻趣談這間娛樂場所的威水史！主持們又到訪文具展覽館與繡花鞋店，實地活用「甩頭筆」、「繡花姑娘打架」等相關歇後語，格外傳神！

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 位於塔崑山附近的住宅，被大片林木與河流包圍，十足世外桃園。「閨密睇樓團」先後參觀復古風、度假風的別墅，敏之還獲高Ling、嘉欣奉上四手按摩，好寫意。高Ling離隊返港途中，打開姊妹們準備的愛心便當，更覺感動！另邊廂，陳凱琳飛抵哥打峇魯會合敏之，隨即到舊式茶室醫肚。道北有「小泰國」之稱，兩位人母試坐地道火車，並交流養兒經。見識過當地最大的坐佛像後，二人化身布藝學徒，投入繪畫、上色步驟，壓力一掃而空。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 牛年新春，衍峰、祖儀、穎彤前往昂坪棧道行大運！無限踏步棧道梯級，運動盲穎彤可會應付得來？考驗未完，三人還要挑戰離地驚險步道！完成辛苦的棧道行程，在昂坪市集品嚐港式小吃，不忘到心經簡林洗滌心靈。Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰實測本地盆菜團，尋覓流水響「天空之鏡」秘境，還有屏山盆菜等着餵飽三人！接着親親羊駝、壁畫村內感受藝術氣息、紅磚屋市集買手信，好圓滿。嘉賓馬貫東帶祖儀到馬灣荒廢舊村打卡，拍出頹廢美感。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 德國於二戰後分裂為東德與西德，由美、英、法、蘇四國分別管理。由於理念各異，民眾生活截然不同，令當時不少東德人希望逃往西德，東德當局遂下令建造柏林圍牆。谷主凱婷講述這段歷史，還展示了柏林圍牆逃亡路線的模擬圖。眾谷們又討論柏林圍牆倒下的原因，汛文、泳嘉猜測是於德國統一後才發生，已作資料搜集的凱婷卻指拍檔倒轉了因果，何出此言？泳嘉曾到訪柏林圍牆，更與著名塗鴉《兄弟之吻》打卡，該幅圖畫的由來又是怎樣？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 一路前行粵普
programme.desc: 一部聚焦中國生態保護，綠色高品質發展的環保公益紀實節目。透過沉浸式觀察新時代環保議題，並邀請胡歌、劉濤、陳龍三位明星親身參與，共同完成一場綠色低碳生活的行動。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 生與死是每個人都要面對、經歷的人生課題，洪永城要四位小朋友填寫死亡證，想像自己的死亡日期、地點、死因等，有女生笑言會因太富有而招致殺身之禍？小朋友如掌握生殺大權，哪些相中生命可殺？哪些不可殺？問到會否吃豬肉時，有人自稱不會殺豬，但別人殺了卻會吃。節目組還會讓一名十一歲女生籌辦生前派對，並邀請其家人、親友出席。主角女孩因父母在台上的分享而感觸，參與活動的洪永城及其他小朋友又有甚麼難忘感受？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 茜向良太和太晴追問怪物的真身，高輪見狀決定把茜帶去超鐵機，並邀請他成為駕駛員，誰知茜聽見「期望」兩字後便一口拒絕。UNKNOWN再次出現，太晴和良太陷入苦戰，危急關頭茜駕駛E6小町號前來助陣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」再次展開，教練Mandy姐姐引領大家以兩張紙張先行熱身，做法是怎樣的？緊接的上身肌力訓練亦全程手持兩張紙來做，除了有游泳、扇風等動作，還會模仿招財貓揮手。另會手持彩虹鐘鍛練下肢肌力，過程中要做出弓步、踢腿等動作，同時要跟隨拍子敲鐘。將耍樂融入運動，有助提升小朋友的鍛練動力。「動物好萌友」環節，帶大家認識唐貓「嬌嬌」之餘，也會介紹貓咪日常如何保持自身清潔。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子發覺世上有很多相似，但實際上是不一樣的東西之後，開始關注這類東西。小丸子與媽媽約定，一起努力收緊生活態度。小丸子要不再懶洋洋，過有規律的生活。而媽媽則是要不貪吃，減肥瘦身。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵
programme.desc: 政府預計今個財年，代表日常開支的經營帳目可以恢復盈餘。面對數年財赤，除了發債，今屆政府合共轉撥了數千億元基金款項到政府一般收入帳目，應付日常開支，這些財政手段是能真的有助改善財赤？基本法規定特區政府要量入為出，但政府開支年年攀升，大幅超過庫房收入，長遠如何維持政府財政健康？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: K Cash業主私人貸款呈獻 :香港系列之細間始終你好粵
programme.desc: 舖頭可以有幾細？「善用」唐樓的樓梯底位置，已可做生意。負責補鞋、配匙、開鎖的店主，一直保持身型，以求於狹窄的空間行動自如，但那裡其實還有很多「偷位」之處？祥師兄駕車到已光顧逾廿年的大牌檔，與第二代老闆在飯桌聚舊，老闆身體勞損仍堅持做足365日，做好雞粥、乳鴿、炒麵！偕著名武指林迪安同往土瓜灣，地下醫館、天台武館，分別由兩姊弟主理，最重要是承傳父親心血，有武術徒弟笑言師父「戇居」，只因一個窩心舉動？

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！曾為家人放棄追夢的居港台灣人、只為在TVB化一次妝的媽媽級挑戰者，分別接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 林曉培亮相節目獻唱新歌<她的眼淚之餘，並與主持冼靖峰合唱<煩。她將在港舉行個唱，還想過將廣東歌放入歌單？「偶像零距離」詹天文回答粉絲提問，粉絲甚麼舉動曾令她大為感動？天文現場演繹<在十字路口告別，作為回饋。涂毓麟與好友韋諾合寫<善良或染的曲詞，箇中的「染」所指為何？兩人還分享特別創作習慣。這集亦會倒數「勁歌金榜」，還有新晉六人男團ALITZ介紹團名背後意義。甫出道就推出專輯又有甚麼用意？

programme.title: 風味人間 第2季粵
programme.desc: 地球上的蟹種繁多，幻化出無窮滋味。來自冰冷海域的帝王蟹，捕撈難度高，挪威不少漁民被其鮮甜味道吸引，每年冒險出海。山林間亦可尋到蟹蹤，雲南山區溪流的山螃蟹，當地人搗碎製醬，成為佐飯佳餚。甘香可口的大閘蟹深受饕客喜愛，未成年就上市的六月黃被視為滋味前菜。威尼斯人窺準於艾氏濱蟹退殼後捕捉，炸成可整隻放入口的軟殼蟹。珠江流域的青蟹，不同成長階段各具風味，當中以黃油蟹最為矜貴，全身滲透甘甜的黃油，令人回味。

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 花劍越來越流行，主持一探比賽規則，並投入試玩，感受劍擊魅力。全接觸空手道允許直接擊打對方，賽制上與傳統空手道有甚麼分別？藝人關楚耀迷上匹克球，積極參賽、考教練牌，還推廣這項新興運動。甲一籃球總決賽第二場，滿貫力求反撲，香港東方又能否乘勝追擊？此外，晉裕男籃走進社區跟街坊拜年。啟德體育園開幕一周年，前港將出席運動體驗日與眾同樂。港隊主場出戰U18男子冰球世錦賽，表現如何？另帶來香港摔跤錦標賽戰報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 人形機械人應用逐漸落地，要分析這類AI下游產業鏈的股份時，要留意甚麼？人大政協兩會召開，適逢今年亦是「十五五」規劃開局之年，會議會如何為中國經濟走向定調？

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 文諾帶晟杰找文雅卻被趕走，晟杰潛入Green World密室遇黑衣人，懷疑是梁曦。Tina燒毀密室證據，晟杰突然來到…曉晨逼問忠仔怎麼虐待文雅，又說服Tina讓晟杰介入調查利民。文諾親自試探，曉晨得知文諾做過心臟移植…

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 港產旅行團粵PG
programme.desc: 牛年新春，衍峰、祖儀、穎彤前往昂坪棧道行大運！無限踏步棧道梯級，運動盲穎彤可會應付得來？考驗未完，三人還要挑戰離地驚險步道！完成辛苦的棧道行程，在昂坪市集品嚐港式小吃，不忘到心經簡林洗滌心靈。Ben Sir、淑雅、衍峰實測本地盆菜團，尋覓流水響「天空之鏡」秘境，還有屏山盆菜等着餵飽三人！接着親親羊駝、壁畫村內感受藝術氣息、紅磚屋市集買手信，好圓滿。嘉賓馬貫東帶祖儀到馬灣荒廢舊村打卡，拍出頹廢美感。

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 德國於二戰後分裂為東德與西德，由美、英、法、蘇四國分別管理。由於理念各異，民眾生活截然不同，令當時不少東德人希望逃往西德，東德當局遂下令建造柏林圍牆。谷主凱婷講述這段歷史，還展示了柏林圍牆逃亡路線的模擬圖。眾谷們又討論柏林圍牆倒下的原因，汛文、泳嘉猜測是於德國統一後才發生，已作資料搜集的凱婷卻指拍檔倒轉了因果，何出此言？泳嘉曾到訪柏林圍牆，更與著名塗鴉《兄弟之吻》打卡，該幅圖畫的由來又是怎樣？

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 位於塔崑山附近的住宅，被大片林木與河流包圍，十足世外桃園。「閨密睇樓團」先後參觀復古風、度假風的別墅，敏之還獲高Ling、嘉欣奉上四手按摩，好寫意。高Ling離隊返港途中，打開姊妹們準備的愛心便當，更覺感動！另邊廂，陳凱琳飛抵哥打峇魯會合敏之，隨即到舊式茶室醫肚。道北有「小泰國」之稱，兩位人母試坐地道火車，並交流養兒經。見識過當地最大的坐佛像後，二人化身布藝學徒，投入繪畫、上色步驟，壓力一掃而空。

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 生與死是每個人都要面對、經歷的人生課題，洪永城要四位小朋友填寫死亡證，想像自己的死亡日期、地點、死因等，有女生笑言會因太富有而招致殺身之禍？小朋友如掌握生殺大權，哪些相中生命可殺？哪些不可殺？問到會否吃豬肉時，有人自稱不會殺豬，但別人殺了卻會吃。節目組還會讓一名十一歲女生籌辦生前派對，並邀請其家人、親友出席。主角女孩因父母在台上的分享而感觸，參與活動的洪永城及其他小朋友又有甚麼難忘感受？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 元宵佳節，三位主持聯同「主婦look」示人的黃建東，闖進銅鑼灣鬧市應節，測試市民對男、女有關歇後語的認識。麥美恩、吳幸美被大學講師廖舜禧問到「拍拖」出處、「氹」字的正寫，可有獨到見解？俗語「三七二十一」出於戰國時代？且聽舜禧溯本尋源。主持們及後到訪鏡畫舖、磁廠及糖水店，又何以搬出「強盜照鏡」、「豬乸噍田螺」、「竹織鴨」等歇後語？「酸薑竹」比喻玩弄女士的男子，鄭寶鴻淺談當中歷史掌故。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 美恩、幸美和茶餐廳老闆有個約會，探究「大髀痛」、「和尚跳海」，以及「打荷」等茶餐廳、食店廚房術語的奧妙。大學講師廖舜禧細談歷史人物歇後語，還講解「茅根竹」等「縮腳歇後語」特色、奄尖的「奄」與打尖的「尖」本字，及「一蚊雞」（一元）出處。「北角夜總會」形容別人經常遲到，掌故專家鄭寶鴻趣談這間娛樂場所的威水史！主持們又到訪文具展覽館與繡花鞋店，實地活用「甩頭筆」、「繡花姑娘打架」等相關歇後語，格外傳神！

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 下白泥是野餐好地點，今集遊戲全部與食物有關。首次參與遊戲的蝦頭，飢餓得要用「泰山壓頂」招數來吃懸在對手頭上的食物，哪位男藝員被寵幸？舉手可招來侍應，舉腳才可進食是甚麼玩法？藝員出醜食相盡呈現！野餐不能缺少三文治，再加上綠色醬料，一場wasabi災難又上演……Bob發揮「神預測」本色，換來全部人員最期待的大懲罰！遊戲盡顯特玩隊的人性醜惡，但天意卻讓他們出線爭獎品，「輸家」連詩雅竟有出頭天！

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 未來、繪萌、凜花、安娜、莎拉、玫兒，還有瑪莉亞、鈴、杏樹、虹之咲合共十位寶石偶像，卻只有一人能被選為鑽石偶像的寶石時裝大賽終於開始。繪萌與安娜順利表演過後，面對觀眾與競爭的壓力，竟令凜花感到不安……

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄見家裡經濟財政緊絀，於是走去尋寶，多啦A夢知道後借他「尋寶機」和「飄浮噴霧」。大雄不小心害靜香的胸針掉進水塘，用過法寶「加醋減醋」後心生一計，但在前往水塘的路上遭遇諸多阻撓。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: 在翼的努力之下，Ultras的工作漸上軌道，但A太卻因為一次誤會而抱怨翼把B-PROJECT放在優先，本身對Ultras頗有微詞的剛士因而與A太發生衝突，詎料此時公司卻下令要B-PROJECT發展YourTube，理想做法自然是請教精於此道的Ultras。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 發掘「魔都」隱世美食，來到地道麵館，婭溦、糖妹按照網上排名點菜，蛤蜊豬肝拌麵、茄盒、腰花辣肉湯麵，果真名不虛傳。光顧傳聞「怪脾氣」師傅蛋糕店、古早味冰糕與人氣脆香鮮肉月餅，風味小吃滋味連連。主持們被「古董花園」復古氛圍吸引，優雅地淺嚐美式鬆餅與造型蛋糕。接着遊逛老上海歐式風格小區，先打卡再覓食。入黑，味蕾試試新口味，主打越南粉的東南亞餐廳，可會是兩位主持杯茶？酒吧內的雞尾酒名字趣怪，越夜越精彩！

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽向來注重固本培元，並以簡單食材製作多款養顏美食，從內到外散發健康風采。莙薘菜又名「豬乸菜」，外表平凡卻含豐富營養。以莙薘菜及多種蔬菜做成的上素卷，質感爽脆口味清新，更是都市人的減壓珍品。炮製「花生眉豆螺頭雞腳湯」要選用「老母雞」，到底有何特別功效？另一佳餚以「自然豬腩片」配上有助抗衰老的紫淮山、鮮百合，刁鑽選材全為吃得更安心。同場加映「秘製蜜汁燒焗豬肋條」，藉着啖啖肉滋味，滿足6號的肉食喜好。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 不同產地的木瓜，質感、甜度各有分別，肥媽和6號往果欄逐一介紹，並為是日「泰好味」餐單搜羅食材。青木瓜沙律拌入豆豉鯪魚，帶來嶄新口感；6號大受刺激，竟模仿阿媽唱腔！用自家製青咖喱醬煮出的「青咖喱雞」，則是「送飯」佳餚。「泰式魚露鳳爪」以檸檬、青檸、白醋等混合的酸汁浸醃，味道層次豐富。期間6號鳳爪、雞腳不分，又提起無骨鳳爪的都市傳聞，被阿媽直斥無知！此外，要令「冬蔭功」內的蝦肉爽口不霉，肥媽有何秘訣？

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 四人到清邁郊外等待看日出，並訴說相關經歷。和嘉洛同往看日出許願竟是兩男？JW最有記憶的日出，是與吳業坤一起拍劇。畏高的JW鼓起勇氣試玩動力滑翔傘，降落即要求擁抱互勉。登艇遊河兼食船麵，甚麼令陳瀅眼濕濕？走進市場，大家開始試吃之行，JW獻出食榴槤第一次。主持們換上民族服，邊品嚐地道美食邊欣賞民族表演。四人分組在周末市集買食物開餐，同時考驗另類默契。挑戰叢林間的過山車與飛索，JW能否再次戰勝恐懼？

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵PG
programme.desc: 深入清邁鄉村逛小店，朱仔竟踴躍發言，拍檔都配合地轉為「靜音模式」。朱仔更挑戰JW底線要其吃蜜蜂蛋，嚇得她落荒而逃！四人分享清邁之旅難忘點滴，有人講到喊，更發覺此行絕對不容嘉洛缺席！大家還透過收到的禮物，競猜自己的「秘密天使」……張振朗、賴慰玲接力出發，辦理飛澳洲的登機手續之際，朱仔驚喜送機，卻是「計中計」，他會乘坐航班的商務位同行。站在海水中央食蠔，可有特別感受？不過，振朗的熟練開蠔技術才是焦點！

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 東海總部出現天才駕駛員，憑一人之力便戰勝UNKNOWN。太晴等人前往名古屋拜會該駕駛員，得知對方叫魚虎天，年紀更少於他們。良太和茜就天的事情發生爭執，天的適性值卻在訓練中突然急遽下降。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 熱愛一件事情，努力去做，一定會有好成績。這回「My Little Show」的兩位表演者，湊巧都是帶來舞蹈演出。想成就一段優美的舞步，相信都曾下過不少苦功，更要克服種種困難，一同看看二人如何藉舞蹈展現自信與活力。很多歌曲都陪着我們成長，寫下了青春印記，彤彤姐姐、玲玲姐姐分別細談小時候喜愛的歌曲與夢想。兩人還在結他導師的伴奏下，一起合唱<青春頌和<一生何求，唱歌的同時，也可細味歌詞中的人生哲理。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 人氣偶像姜姜主演的電影片場收到怪盜M的犯罪預告，說要偷走傳說中的寶刀玻璃丸，屁屁偵探應小鈴請求去到片場，眾人在導演安排下參與電影拍攝，屁屁偵探揭破姜姜的經理人扁口魚是怪盜M假冒。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 宏志嚮往鄉郊生活，但遭到媽媽反對，適逢鄉郊有人賣屋，宏志於是帶同小丸子和爺爺去看屋。老人會舉行馬拉松比賽，詎料未開始已有過半數人棄權，為了吸引家人參加，友藏訛稱比賽有豐富獎品。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 潛行天下粵
programme.desc: 《潛行天下》以全球海洋為主題，採用8K超高清攝影機和水下無人機等技術建構沉浸式觀影體驗，跨越四大洋14國水域拍攝，記錄雙髻鯊、鯨鯊等海洋生物活動，探密三沙永樂龍洞等特殊地形。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 中國人愛金，根據世界黃金協會統計，2024年中國人的黃金購買量連續12年位居世界第一。地緣政局不穩，黃金作為資金避難所，價格創下歷史新高，升穿5,500美元一盎司。有業內人士指，現正經歷「黃金大時代」。而白銀亦追落後，兩者價格大幅波動。金銀價格大起大跌，對業內人士有何衝擊? 又如何應對呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 導師分組賽繼續上演，紅隊布志綸、紫隊高少華、綠隊張嘉銘三大導師帶領下，舉行三個回合的合唱比拼，各隊代表組合分別演繹Beyond樂隊、王菲、林憶蓮的作品。這集最低分的隊伍，會有兩人被淘汰。

programme.title: 一周星星粵
programme.desc: 太極樂隊加入樂壇40年，成軍是更久的日子，如何維繫友誼？「你問我答」有歌手卻疑似目睹他們曾黑面吵架，事實又是如何？泳兒的提問，竟令劉賢德被指有所偏心！訪談其間，朱翰博突然自稱「萬能插蘇」，這別名因何得來？也講起某成員的投資之道，不論是照相機鏡頭還是身邊伴侶，都穩有盈餘？入行40周年演唱會，可準備了甚麼驚喜？太極還會在螢幕前演繹<紅色跑車、<留住我吧、<全人類高歌等金曲，讓樂迷們先聽為快！

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 胡美貽與鼎爺品嚐古法粵菜，包括鮮味十足的鷓鴣粥、工序繁複的雞子戈渣，以及肉嫩多汁的黑松露手撕炸子雞，令人回味無窮。伍倩彤走訪上環的排隊熱店，遍嚐充滿創意的特脆菠蘿包、氮氣奶茶及韓式炸雞意式三文治，滋味獨特。胡美貽再駕車載廖慧儀前往大美督，到訪慧儀推介的隱世台式餐廳，試吃滿漢三寶牛肉麵、麻辣鴨血冬粉，風味正宗。Agnes則帶施焯日細嚐新派精緻福建菜，永春老醋海蜇凍酸香濃郁、紅蟳糯米飯鮮味「爆燈」！

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 叠影狙擊#6粵PG
programme.desc: 晟杰質問曉晨為何出現在密室中，曉晨自知瞞不住，只好帶晟杰到飛飛家，但去到後發現飛飛已被發哥抓走。曉晨和晟杰趕到貨倉贖飛飛之時，遇上霆釗及其手下，曉晨展現出她的好身手，並開槍擊斃殺手，令晟杰感到詫異。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾星戲癮發作，合演特工小劇場，旨在介紹逾百年歷史的特工主題餐廳。桌上甫見到豬肉的肥膏，朱仔隨即想起陳瀅？深入文創藝術村買手信，女生盡顯默契；四人更一起DIY手繩，陳瀅卻嫌JW破壞文青氣氛？走進聚集年輕人的市集，陳瀅獲飾品店主贈送禮物，令嘉洛要向店主問明原因！店主的熱情舉動反讓陳瀅歉疚，她即為三名拍檔買禮物，卻差點因為一隻卡通玩偶激怒朱仔？去泰國梗要按摩！兩女久候嘉洛、朱仔，要化身按摩女郎戲弄他們！

programme.title: 約埋班Friend去旅行粵
programme.desc: 眾主持登上雙龍寺參拜，順道俯瞰清邁市風景。來到小孩遊樂場，嘉洛童心大發，陳瀅勉強陪玩，JW自認老了？兩男試玩人造沖浪卻跌不停，嘉洛還遇上小意外，引來女拍檔們追究？邊吃邊聊，JW揭露陳瀅曾致電向她哭訴。泰式餐廳設有一個園林美景，眾人彷如置身於仙境中用餐。怎料嘉洛餐後大意遺下銀包，被陳瀅手抓到報復機會……入夜返回酒店，大家齊集玩問答遊戲。一條誰人最有義氣的問題，陳瀅的答案卻令兩男傷心「中箭」？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 很多父母都有一套取悅兒女的「殺手鐧」，好爸爸李忠希了解兩歲半囡囡最愛甜食，因此經常炮製簡單甜品，讓女兒透過味蕾品嚐父親對她的關愛。泡芙製作過程看似簡單，但不少朋友在家中試做時卻不知從何入手。「甜品達人」古嘉俊就跟大家分享心得，示範一款口感和味道皆與眾不同的「椰子杏仁泡芙」。以牛油曲奇配搭外脆內軟的泡芙，創意十足。泡芙外層換上黃糖製成的酥皮，造型彷如港式菠蘿包，箇中構思是否與忠希最愛懷舊甜品有關？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 實習生的新一個實習課頭是有機會前往神樹坪繁育園或都江堰康養區，他們剛好有機會見證熊貓寶寶誕生的一刻；站長給他們介紹怎樣照顧大熊貓生產前的起居飲食；另一位飼養員則給他們介紹怎樣照顧初生熊貓寶寶。

programme.desc: 歡迎來到木瓜島！這是一個與世隔絕的地方，有著獨特又古怪的傳統，木瓜島的每個孩子都有小牛看護者，除了一個不知怎麼來到島上的孩子－－卡庫佩，經過種種努力，終於得到一隻神經質的小牛蘇格拉底。而這對特別的搭檔，將會挑戰木瓜島的傳統……

programme.title: 豆小鴨神奇小分隊
programme.desc: 單純直率的豆小鴨總是不小心闖禍，還好他有最棒的好朋友－－善解人意的袋熊沃蓓，和熱愛發明的小豬奇姆！只要三個人在一起，不管遇到任何困難，都能運用創意找到有趣的方法解決，把日常生活的所有危機，變成精彩好玩的大冒險！快快快，一起來山谷洞玩吧！

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 家宴
programme.desc: 【離家追夢，還是回家團圓？馮家菜北漂生存戰】馮家菜是北京頗具名氣的淮揚菜館，女強人大米憑藉一身拼勁，將小館打造成金字招牌，卻因妹夫欠債，陷入食品安全風波，生意一落千丈。為救餐館，她請出退休父親參賽，奪得全國冠軍，卻招來資本大鱷周路的覬覦。親情與利益交織，事業與愛情碰撞，兄妹間信任破裂，馮家菜面臨生死存亡。當大米病倒，家庭崩解，弟弟豆子終於悔悟，全家攜手重建家業。當揚州炒飯再次上桌，家的味道，未曾改變。

programme.title: 生活家
programme.desc: 【金馬演員攜手演出破產母女生存記】少見的審計職場劇，樂觀正向，帶給人心激勵。從小在拮据家庭成長的邱冬娜，在課業工作上總是特別勤奮，希望透過自己的努力讓母親過上好生活。畢業後，因緣際會下進入了前輩顧飛開的審計稽核公司，面對孤僻但能力強的主管顧飛，邱冬娜雖然頭痛但絕不認輸！運用從母親身上學到的智慧，還有艱困生活帶給她的精打細算體質，邱冬娜總能屢出奇招化解艱難任務。曾有心理創傷的主管顧飛，也在邱冬娜的陪伴下，兩人亦師亦友,相互扶持鼓勵，逐漸治癒傷口，成為彼此的靈魂伴侶。

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 另一種藍
programme.desc: 【宋茜邂逅周渝民，事業失意返鄉傳承青花瓷再現風華！！】北漂少女陳小滿努力工作、省吃儉用為求入股家族瓷器事業，卻以失敗收場，毅然決然回景德鎮專心學習瓷器工藝。陳小滿工作的上司柯巖則在投資上遭遇前所未有的失利，輾轉來到景德鎮。處於低潮的兩人在互相治癒中重新找回站起來的力量，事業重新起步，愛情也開始萌芽。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 壞記憶橡皮擦
programme.desc: 【金在中攜陳世娫出演新劇《壞記憶橡皮擦》回歸電視劇！！】曾是被看好的網球之星李君，在負傷之後喪失了自尊心，認為自己從人生的主角變成配角。遇上腦研究中心的醫生景珠妍，使用了記憶橡皮擦抹去了過去記憶，重生為運動經紀人，而景珠妍也意外成了他的初戀。因被篡改的記憶開始的羅曼史，在得知真相后其結局將會如何呢？

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (S1) - Circus
programme.desc: It's Teletubby Circus time! Tinky Winky balances on the tight rope, Dipsy juggles, Laa-Laa flies on the trapeze and Po is a funny clown.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the entire family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Purple Darts
programme.desc: A girl vows to take revenge for her parents who were murdered by four outlaws when she was only a baby. To do so, she trains hard at martial arts and teams up with a swordsman and a couple to finally kill them all.

programme.title: Pale Passion
programme.desc: Fa is an obsessive man who loves his wife Ah Hsia but is easily jealous and abuses her. When she leaves him one day, Fa hooks up with another woman, Hsing. A deadly triangle develops when Fa runs into Ah Hsia again and decides to win her back...

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A Wu Dang disciple Fu, kills the chief of Wu Dang Clan and frames it on the chief's illegitimate child, Yun. Fu then proclaims himself the new chief and orders the killing of Yun, who vows to avenge his father's death and learns the invincible silkworm martial arts style in order to defeat Fu.

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Mad Monk is up against the equally legendary scholar-turned-genie, Lu Tung Pin. The duo create havoc as they vie with each other, be it in mirth, magic, women or weapons!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin. Wen saved Lin and battles the abbot to avenge his dead sworn brothers. With Lin and his army's help, they bring down the ruthless monks in the monastery.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: The film starts out with two students fighting for their deceased master's sword called the "Green Frost Sword". Han kills the other student, takes the sword and offer it to the king. The wife of the other dead student plots to take revenge, going undercover to retrieve the sword at the first opportunity in this tale of revenge and betrayal.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eaton's location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Gordon Liu plays an anti-Manchu rebel who escapes to the Shaolin Temple and learns what it truly takes to become a martial arts master by challenging the 35 Shaolin Kung Fu chambers, eventually creating the 36th chamber himself.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: This supernatural mystery tells the story of a sickly wife and her maid conspiring to kill her beastly husband, leading to a string of events with spooky twists and turns.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mist Over Dream Lake
programme.desc: A young girl Chen is sent away by her parents who are going through divorce, to stay with the Chang's. On the Chang's farm, she meets their two sons, the youngest daughter and a young artist, and spends a summer with them that she will never forget.

programme.title: One Way Only
programme.desc: Danny is a motorbike workshop owner, once was a renowned motorcycle racer, but were seriously injured in an illegal race. Mai, student of Danny, wins a race in Macau under Danny's help. However, because of money and honour, Mai joins illegal races. After knowing this, Li persuades Mai to stop illegal races, but Mai seems cannot find his way out...

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: The 5 Billion Dollar Legacy
programme.desc: A crippled billionaire mails a letter to each of his long-lost daughters inviting them to go to Japan, in the hope that he will find a worthy heir to inherit his vast fortune. The sisters finally meet abroad the plane to Japan, and one of them is taken with a man who is going to investigate the death of his lawyer uncle in a mysterious hit-and-run.

programme.title: Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan...

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping. During the trip, a spoiled kid Li is attracted to Ping but Su thinks Ping has fallen for Tung and leaves. How will Ping deal with the situation and ends up happily back with Su?

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: After many years as a respected actor and action choreographer, the Shaw Studio finally gave the dependable and commendable Hsu Hsia a chance to direct his own movies. He didn't waste the opportunity, inviting three other kung-fu designers to help on this fight-filled thriller. Wang Yu, co-star of such classics as Dirty Ho and The Kid With A Tattoo, here takes center stage as a young rascal caught between an anti-Ching Confederation and violent, vengeful Ching troops.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: The movie consists of four stories of the Mad Monk helping others, from saving a mother and daughter from crumbling walls, to helping hawkers deal with bullies, recovering stolen money for a young man and punishing a devious court official and his son.

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Japanese karate master and Diao Er, who has been expelled from his martial arts school, return to the school to kill the school master and his disciples. After the massacre, disciple Lei Ming embarks on a vigorous training regime and vows to avenge their deaths. A fatal battle is about to begin...

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: When the head of a manor loses his kung fu skills, he enlists his nephew and fiancee to escort gold to the capital. Along the way, they encounter a mysterious swordsman and join forces with him to stop bandits from stealing the gold.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: This was one of top three films of 1970 and winner of "Outstanding Drama" at the 9th Golden Horse Awards. The evil minister uses twelve golden medallions to summon war hero Yueh Fei back from the frontline and execute him. A group of wandering warriors, led by Yueh Hua and Chin Ping, try to stop the medallion couriers.

programme.title: Tiger Killer
programme.desc: Wu Song is appointed as chief constable after killing a tiger with his bare hands when drunk. The wife of his brother Wu Da Lang, seduces Wu Song but gets rejected by him, and engages in an affair with a rich man. They poison Wu Da Lang when he finds out about their affair. To avenge his brother's death, Wu Song kills both of them.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - "Black Leopard". Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of "Black Leopard", except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: The Deadly Knives
programme.desc: Martial arts student Yen returns from school to defend his family homestead against Japanese financiers after his father is killed. On the way, he meets Hua and falls in love with her. However, Hua discovers that her father is plotting with the Japanese to take Yen's property and wants to murder him. It is a tough choice between family and love...

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Three hundred thousand worth of silver is robbed by a thief using a whip as the weapon. As it is a signature weapon used by a martial arts master "Shadow Whip", he is suspected and hunted. No one sees him after that. Fifteen years later, a young girl Yang shows up using the same weapon. Who is this girl and what has happened to "Shadow Whip"?

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: A crippled woman seeks vengeance against the four men who killed her parents. However, when she crosses path with a young warrior who falls in love with her, trouble ensues as his father is one of the killers responsible for her family's massacre years ago.

programme.title: Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: This masterpiece spins three interconnected tales about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from love. Follow a trio of Hong Kong women as they explore relationships and fulfil their hopes of finding true love.

programme.title: The Villains
programme.desc: Hung is an orphan seeking help from her wealthy uncle who has two sons but only dotes on the younger son Feng, a playboy. Feng covets the beauty of Hung and rapes her but when she gets pregnant, Hung is wrongfully accused and gets sent off by her uncle to protect Feng. Will Feng be punished for his villainy?

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiance so as to drive away two women whom he does not like...

programme.title: Tales of a Eunuch
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao enters the palace and unexpectedly befriends Emperor Kang Xi. At the same time, he is assigned by a revolutionary group to steal the valuable "Sutra of 42 Chapters," which Emperor Kang Xi himself is also seeking. Demonstrating keen intelligence, Xiao Bao deftly navigates between opposing factions and successfully evades danger.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Sword Stained with Royal Blood
programme.desc: Adapted from Jin Yong's novel, the movie depicts the havoc breaking out in the martial arts world when a warrior on the run uncovers a sword, a training manual, a treasure map and a secret message on the body of a deceased martial arts master.

programme.title: The House of 72 Tenants
programme.desc: The 72 inhabitants of a dilapidated tenement live under the thumb of a heartless landlady and her sleazy husband. The arrival of a defiant new tenant however, changes their fate. The residents pool their resources together to prevent evictions, deflect targeted harassment by a corrupt policeman and ultimately prevent their home from being sold.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan. Chow Ping from the Chow Clan is a student of Wong's caught in the Mong's territory and as punishment, the Mong Clan wants to cut off Chow Ping's limbs. Wong steps in to defend his student.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: Mr Vampire II
programme.desc: Grave-robbing archaeologists unearth a family of preserved vampires and plan to sell them on the black market. However, they accidentally break the paper spells that had kept the vampires immobilized during transport. The vampires escape, but a local herbalist Lin is soon on their trail, determined to destroy them.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man's matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Oily Maniac
programme.desc: Famous director Ho Meng-hua, who gave Jackie Chan and Sammo Hung acting breaks in his early kung-fu films, broke new ground with his horror hit Oily Maniac. Based on a true story about a creature that kills people at night and covers them in oil, it stars young actor Danny Lee (aka. Li Hsiu-hsien) as the oily maniac. It was considered so scary that it was censored drastically.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory in an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help other coworkers leave safely and fight to kill the monster!

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in time to 500 years ago to kill the Dragon Master, in order to reverse the act. Little did she know that the Dragon King and Dragon Master were close friends back then...

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a "super pill" invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. B's superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: The Bare-footed Kid
programme.desc: A poor, bare-footed young man from the countryside arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his father's near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: Lawyer Yip defends a rapist and gets him acquitted. Yip's boyfriend Fong, a police inspector, knows he is guilty and despises Yip for not upholding justice. The victim's sister takes revenge by spiking the rapist's drink but is raped instead. This puts the rapist back in court. Will Yip choose to uphold law or justice this time?

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world champion boxer Fai meets fiery young fighter Qi in Macau. As he mentors Qi for an upcoming MMA tournament, Fai rekindles his passion for fighting, life, and the people he cares about.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: The Case of Disappearances
programme.desc: In Misty Village, the adopted son Wen Jie is haunted by a recurring nightmare. He delves into a series of disappearance cases in the village to seek his true identity. As more villagers die mysteriously, belief in the curse of Emperor Jing Lung intensifies. Wen Jie teams up with the security chief to unveil the conspiracy and protect the villagers.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: During World War II, a singer was raped and killed by Master Tao during her escape, with all her valuables stolen as well. Since then, the Tao's house became haunted. Years later, Master Tao's descendant sells the house to a young couple to pay off a massive gambling debt, but the couple soon discover that it is haunted by the vengeful spirit...

programme.title: Wusong VS Ximenqing
programme.desc: Wu Song finds out about his sister-in-law's affair with a rich man, Ximen Qing. Qing sets Song up and have him exiled for a year, during which his hapless brother is murdered and cremated. When Song finally returns home, he takes the case to court but the judge brushes it aside and closes it abruptly. Can Song finally avenge his brother's death?

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuk's pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop, and he must find his younger self to team up to find the power of time. As the six-eared Macaque Monkey also wants the power of time, they clash in a fierce battle...

programme.title: Casino Tycoon II
programme.desc: This is a sequel to "Casino Tycoon". 20 years after Benny Ho established his casino empire in Macau, his former partner becomes envious and plots to bring him down. At the same time, a young man working for Benny is the son of his ex-lover, and is also out to take revenge on him. Ho however, is not about to take things lying down...

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining. Three young men, Sammo Hung, Jackie Chan and Yuen Biao, are determined to train under Master Yu and undergo extremely tough training before they become three of Hong Kong's biggest stars

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his father's land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laika's mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn...

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap. It is at this time that Chen falls for a beautiful girl May, who thinks he is a company chauffeur...

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: The leader of Dragon clan, Long Er, helps General Wu to overthrow Emperor Kang Xi. However, Long Er is betrayed by General Wu and is rescued by Xiao Bao. As a result, she bestows her virginity and martial arts power to Xiao Bao to fight against Wu. At the same time, Xiao Bao fortuitously unveils the hidden treasures from "The Sutra of 42 Chapters".

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: After the Sino-Japanese war, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man and his family experience hardship in their hometown and eventually moved to Hong Kong for a new life. He wants to open a martial arts school in Hong Kong, but first he must pass and win the challenges put forth by the local martial arts grandmasters.

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: Taoist conman Ming fails to banish vengeful spirits and escapes with his ghostly companions. As they seek refuge in a village, they encounter an evil witch whose goal is to eliminate the human race. Ming then allies with Taoist priest Master Jiu to battle the witch-but can they prevail against such overwhelming darkness?

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognize.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: Model Min is admitted to a hospital, but mysteriously falls to her death at night. Rumour has it that the hospital is haunted. Subsequently, Min's photographer begins receiving eerie phone calls, the writer loses consciousness in a bizarre car accident, and her friend mysteriously disappears...

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley's mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her father's debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her father's wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: She is in Danger
programme.desc: After a fight with her boyfriend, Xue leaves home to stay in a remote B&amp;B accommodation, together with a roommate Yi. One night, Xue accidentally discovers that Yi and another friend have killed Yi's ex-boyfriend, and is locked up by the duo so as to cover up the murder. Xue's buddy, Wen, comes seeking for her - can Xue and Wen escape from danger?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student's family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhang's custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: The Sorcerer & The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Magnificent Scoundrels

As both sides know the other's true identity, they join forces to con the loan shark into a trap.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Night Patroll
programme.desc: TheTrollhunters struggle to keep Trolls a secret in Arcadia.

programme.title: Trollhunters: Tales of Arcadia S2 - Arcadia's Most Wanted
programme.desc: To stop the crime wave that has been hitting Arcadia, the Trollhunters must search for a missing Troll.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Polarizing Plight of the Pitiless Poopetrators
programme.desc: George and Harold want Cash Networth to buy the camp and fire Krupp. But before he'll agree to pony up the dough, Cash has a small request of his own.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants And The Senseless Torment Of The Space Toilet
programme.desc: Inspired by their favorite TV show, George and Harold - along with Principal Krupp - blast off to outer space, where an angry toilet awaits.

programme.title: The Epic Tales of Captain Underpants S2 - Captain Underpants and the Abandoned Artifact of the Absentee Aliens
programme.desc: After George and Harold learn the truth about their mission, Dupe Licitous enlists the entire crew in a quest to repair a rogue satellite.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Turf War
programme.desc: It's a turf war when Bounce House Bruiser Baby encroaches on Delivery Baby's tricycle park! Tina attempts to befriend Bruiser in order to woo her back to the bounce house, but naughty behavior is the only language Bruiser understands. Determined to win this kid over, Tina ends up going rogue as a trike hoodlum, and her own field team is forced to reign her in.

programme.title: Boss Baby: Back in the Crib S3 - Trading Up
programme.desc: Boss takes an overdue vacation day, and ends up teaching Tabitha the value of "trading up" valueless objects into something she actually wants, an electric scooter. However, a 5%er baby is in trouble and BB's field team has "got it under control"… or do they? Boss tries to juggle his Tabitha lessons with sneaking peeks at the mission in progress

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Return Of The Gladiator
programme.desc: A Voltron-Sized Robot Beast attacks Planet Arus. While Voltron defends the innocent inhabitants, Shiro searches for answers about his lost time as a Galra captive.

programme.title: Voltron: Legendary Defender S1 - Fall Of The Castle Of Lions
programme.desc: When a Galra Commander infiltrates the castle and destroys its power crystal, the team must protect Voltron from falling into the wrong hands.

programme.title: Spirit Riding Free S1 - Lucky And The Mysterious Map
programme.desc: During a camping trip Jim gives Lucky and the girls a treasure map that sends them on the adventure of a lifetime

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Monkeys Swing In The Trees
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Monkey used to play on the ground and he loved to wind up Crocodile. One day the Big Rains came and Monkey got stranded up the Mango Tree. Nasty Crocodile promised to take him to dry land…. But only in exchange for one thing…. His HEART! Monkey tricked Crocodile and when Crocodile found out that Monkey swapped his heart for a measley mango, he chased Monkey up a tree.

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Tickbird Sits On Hippos Back
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Tickbird didn't sit on Hippo's back, infact they weren't friends at all! Tickbird was sick of Hippo splashing all the time. One day tiny Tickbird challenges big Hippo to a contest… who can drink the most water in a single gulp! Tickbird outwits Hippo by using the tides and from that day she is allowed to sit on Hippo's back and pick off all the yummy ticks she can eat! Tales from Africa.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Home Is Where The Hatch Is
programme.desc: Breeze and Roary swap places for the day (and night). Roary soon discovers the beach is no place for a racing car to live, while Breeze misses the freedom of the beach.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Putting On A Show
programme.desc: The cars are all gleaming for this evening's race. Roary gets bored and heads out onto the track - with disastrous consequences. Will the cars be ready in time for the big show?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Motor Mouth
programme.desc: The track inspector is coming to visit and Big Chris is too tired to commentate on the race. A celebrity commentator is brought in to save the day - much to Big Chris' anger.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Dancing Queen
programme.desc: Christine is due to take part in a dancing competition and is practising at Silver Hatch. But what happens when her dance partner is taken ill?

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Homesick Tin Top
programme.desc: Tin Top just can't master corners no matter how hard he tries. The other cars try to help him to no avail… until Roary hits on a brilliant plan.

programme.title: Roary The Racing Car S2 - Save Our Tree
programme.desc: Mr Carburettor is planning on cutting down Flash's tree. What can be done to save the poor rabbit's home?

programme.title: Not Quite Narwhal S1 - Playground Sparkless
programme.desc: Cruz decides to turn the sunken ship into a park. But all his and Kelp’s "fun-crastinating" puts the project in jeopardy. Kelp accidentally knocks a boulder into the stream, blocking the flow while trying his unicorn spark. Frustrated by magic, Kelp uses the narwhal way.

programme.title: Dragons: Rescue Riders S1 - Iced Out

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Ty And Revvit

programme.title: Dinotrux S1 - Scrapadactyls

programme.title: Tinga Tinga Tales S1 - Why Spider Has A Tiny Waist
programme.desc: You see there was a time when Spider didn't have a tiny waist. She was all big and round… and did she like her food! One day greedy Spider hears of Four Feasts in Tinga Tinga and she wanted to go to them all! So she spun four threads and attached them to various animals going to the feasts. But the Monkeys, Frog, Hippo and the Bees all set off in different directions - North, South, East and West - and Spider's thread soon runs out.
